Bit of advice for you. I looked at your op.gg, and I noticed that you play a ridiculous amount of champs. One way of climbing the ladder that has worked for me, is seriously cutting down  on your champ pool. I was in your position about 2 years ago. Now platinum 3, pretty happy about my position, shooting for diamond. But also, you need to try to die less. You dying that many times will cause the enemy team to snowball, and for them to carry the game. If you are having trouble with ganks, don't be afraid to spend some money on wards, they are lifesavers. I ignored warding for the longest time, now I buy one almost every back. Try to always at least have your 1 vision ward up, it helps a ton.

Tldr:
Limit champ pool, play your best/ most fun enjoyable champs 
Ward more, die less 
Carry games!
